# Acceptance Criteria Validation (Shared)

Use this workflow for any prompt that validates implementation against acceptance criteria.

## Steps
1. Map each acceptance criterion to specific changes or artifacts.
2. Verify completeness against the requirement intent.
3. Check edge cases explicitly mentioned or implied.
4. Document gaps or partial coverage.

## Output Table
Insert the AC validation table from `.github/prompts/includes/ac-validation-template.md` and populate it with evidence (files/line ranges) and notes.
